english.note: This is the all-purpose term for the philosophical idea that only the self can be known or exists.

examples.english: In philosophy, solipsism holds that only the existence of the self can be certain.
examples.traditional: 喺哲學上，唯我論主張只有自我嘅存在先至可以確定。
